title: feat(editor): sticky notes
body: fix https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/9696 supersedes https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/10001 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cab08279-d57e-4c51-927c-e19d1cb8d8dd ## Summary A new `stickynote` element and tool (`N`): an always-filled, flat-rendered note whose label auto-fits. The font shrinks from the user's size down to a floor, and only then does the note grow. Notes are their own color domain, show their creation date in a footer, and are supported by the skeleton API. Builds on `element.created` from #12060. The pixel-snapping work that came out of this is #12063. ## How it works **Model.** A note is two elements: a `stickynote` container and one bound `text` label, on the existing bound-text machinery (wysiwyg editor, font and alignment actions, search, export). Two fields carry the user's intent. `baseHeight` on the note is the height the user gave it; `height = max(baseHeight, content)`, so a note never shrinks below its base and grows only when the label can't fit at the minimum font. `fontSizeMax` on the label is the font ceiling; the label's `fontSize` is the fitted, derived value. The note's width is the wrap width. **Layout.** One pure function, `getStickyNoteLayout(container, label, intents)`, is the single source of truth: it wraps the text at the note's width, fits the font under the ceiling (a grid of `STICKY_NOTE_FONT_STEP` anchored at the ceiling, warm-started binary search, floor at 16), grows the note past `baseHeight` only when the text still overflows at the minimum, and positions the label. It is applied through `updateStickyNoteLayout` (a live scene; runs the bound-arrow pass by default, callers forward `simultaneouslyUpdated` or opt out when they own one) and `relayoutStickyNotes` (an identity-preserving post-pass for immutable action results). Every recompute path goes through it: typing, paste, restore, resize, font actions, the skeleton API. **Resize intents.** `getStickyNoteResizeIntent` turns a gesture into absolute `baseHeight` / `fontSizeMax` intents from the gesture-start snapshot on every move: a width-only drag re-wraps, a height drag sets the base, a proportional resize (Shift on any handle, aspect-locked multi-select, a Stats group edit) scales the ceiling, anything else leaves the text size alone. North handles keep the bottom edge, Alt keeps the center. **Creation.** A click places a 250×250 note centered on the pointer. A drag is previewed at the true dragged size and snaps on release to a font-aware minimum (75, or one line at the current ceiling plus padding, plus the footer vertically), with the origin corner fixed; a Shift drag stays square. Editing starts right away. **Colors.** Notes are a separate domain: `currentItemStickynoteStrokeColor` (the note's ink, which is its text color) and `currentItemStickynoteBackgroundColor`, with their own customizable top-pick slots (`colorTopPicks.stickyNoteStroke` / `stickyNoteBackground`) and transparent excluded. `resolveColorTarget(appState, elements, property)` decides regular / sticky / mixed at execution time from the selection, the active tool and the label being edited, and drives the two pickers, both eyedroppers and paste styles; a mixed selection writes both domains. A note and its label share one ink: `syncStickyNoteInk` keeps the container's `strokeColor` and the label's equal after every write (the label wins on conflict, a transparent label takes the note's color). The stroke picker reads "Text color" for notes. **Creation-date footer.** Every note reserves a 32px band under the label body and paints `element.created` there as an absolute date, "7 Sep" while the year is the current one and "7 Sep 2025" otherwise, in the note's ink, on canvas and in SVG export. The form is chosen by width bucket rather than measured, so painting stays measurement-free (server-side SVG export has no text measurer). Fixed English, the viewer's local time zone (the exporter's for export). The band is reserved even when `created` is null; it just stays empty. **Rendering.** Flat: a solid fill with slightly jittered corners (seeded PRNG, now in `@excalidraw/common`), a drop shadow and an edge shadow, painted identically on canvas and SVG, with no roughjs involvement. The label renders as ordinary bound text. **Restore and API.** Restore clamps and seeds: `fontSizeMax` from `fontSize` when missing, non-transparent colors, the size floor, one ink per note; it refits geometry only under `refreshDimensions`. Skeleton: `{ type: "stickynote", x, y, label?: { text, fontSize? } }` creates a note with a fitted label (see the element-skeleton docs). **Toolbar.** The sticky tool sits on `N`. The image tool moved into "More tools" on desktop and tablet (mobile keeps its slot), and tool badges show the letter shortcuts since the numbered row is no longer contiguous; the number keys keep working. ## Things to be aware of - A note's `strokeColor` is its text color; no stroke is ever painted. Any code that writes a sticky label's `strokeColor` must write the container's too, or run `syncStickyNoteInk`, because the footer paints with it. - `fontSizeMax` is the user setting and `fontSize` is derived. Read and write font sizes through `getUserFontSize` / `getUserFontSizeUpdate`, which are container-aware; writing `fontSize` on a label directly is undone by the next layout. - `height >= baseHeight` always, and `baseHeight` only changes through height gestures, creation and Stats. Content growth never promotes into the base. - Two size floors: the data floor `STICKY_NOTE_MIN_SIZE` (75) that restore and the normalizers enforce, and the font-aware UI floor at creation and resize. - The footer reservation is unconditional and part of the layout (`STICKY_NOTE_BODY_INSET_Y`), so the editor, the fit and both renderers agree; footer metrics live in `STICKY_NOTE_FOOTER`. Dates are in the exporter's time zone in exports; no locale plumbing yet. - Arrows bound to a note follow its growth; exactly one bound-arrow pass runs per installing path. - Deferred on purpose: refitting notes when their font finishes loading (a note typed before the font loads keeps fallback-font geometry until the next edit); a sticky-specific palette beyond the top picks; a creator/ownership footer; localized dates. Pasting styles from a container onto free text drops the label's font styles, a pre-existing bug slated for the copy/paste-styles rewrite. ### vertical padding footer not included in the text padding offset by default (if there's enough space) so that it's visually vertically centered: ## Test plan - [x] `yarn test:typecheck`, ESLint, full vitest suite - [x] Element-level: layout and fit (termination, warm start, lowered ceilings, growth and shrink-back), resize intents across handles and modifiers, rotation, minimum sizes, date labels and width buckets, ink sync (34 tests) - [x] App-level: creation by click and drag, colors and eyedroppers in and out of edit mode, bound arrows through typing, resize, font changes and multi-select, paste styles, Stats, undo, SVG and canvas export with dates (24 tests), plus the color-target resolver, restore, skeleton, drag-create and created-timestamp suites - [x] Manual: create by click and by drag, type until the note grows, Shift-resize, pick colors while editing, both eyedroppers, export SVG and PNG with a dated note, dark mode (fable-5-1, gpt-6-astra)
